exposure: placental diseases (marginal placenta previa, placenta accreta, central placenta previa, low-lying placenta)
cohort: The study included 1824 patients who experienced postpartum hemorrhage during natural delivery and were admitted to the Fourth Hospital of Shijiazhuang between January 1, 2014, and December 31, 2018.
finding: Several factors, including BMI before pregnancy, past history of postpartum hemorrhage, various prepartum and pre-transfusion blood parameters, specific placental diseases, IVF-ET pregnancy, and antepartum hemorrhage, were identified as independent risk factors for sPPH.
mod_finding: A previous history of cesarean section was identified as an independent risk factor for sPPH among patients experiencing natural delivery.
